title: pecluma atra
intro: Pecluma atra, commonly known as the Black Polypody fern, is a type of species of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Pecluma atra are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
